profile: model complexity: Model complexity refers to how 'wiggly' a tuned model fit is. We only control complexity indirectly by how we set both capacity and optimization dials. Therefore, the complexity of a tuned model is not directly adjustable; it is determined by capacity and optimization settings, and it reflects the behavior of the tuned fit.
